parts.title: Listening Part 5
parts.instructions: You will hear Victoria talking to her dad about where her friends stayed on holiday. Where did each person stay? For each question, write a letter (A–H).

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: So Victoria, did your friends have a good holiday?

script.speaker: Victoria
script.text: Yes, most of them did.

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: Good. Where did Liam go?

script.speaker: Victoria
script.text: He went to a lake, somewhere near here. They took a tent.

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: Oh, so he stayed at a <u>campsite</u>?

script.speaker: Victoria
script.text: Yes. He said it was fun.

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: What about Daniel? Where did he go?

script.speaker: Victoria
script.text: He went to the beach with his family. They wanted to stay in a hotel but there were no rooms.

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: Oh no.

script.speaker: Victoria
script.text: It was OK. <u>They rented an apartment</u> instead. It was really nice.

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: Good. And Melissa?

script.speaker: Victoria
script.text: She went to Spain. <u>They stayed in a really big hotel</u> with a pool.

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: Lovely! And what about Alba?

script.speaker: Victoria
script.text: She went somewhere really cool. <u>They stayed in an old castle</u>!

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: Wow! That sounds amazing.

script.speaker: Victoria
script.text: Yes, she said it was beautiful but a bit cold at night.

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: And Martin?

script.speaker: Victoria
script.text: He didn't go far. <u>He stayed at his friend's house</u> in the next town.

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: That's nice. What about Olivia?

script.speaker: Victoria
script.text: <u>She stayed in a small guest house</u> by the sea. She said the food there was excellent.

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: Sounds like everyone had a great time.

parts.title: Reading & Writing Part 4
parts.instructions: For each question, choose the correct answer.
parts.passage:
Competition winner

I'm Sophie and I won a wonderful (1) .......... in a competition! My teacher told us about this competition, and I decided to enter.

I won a (2) .......... to Guadeloupe, a beautiful island in the Caribbean. When I arrived, I (3) .......... a man at the airport. He drove me to the hotel and was my guide.

The people in Guadeloupe (4) .......... French and Creole. I could understand some French from my lessons at school.

I (5) .......... at the hotel for a week. I went swimming in the sea every day and visited many interesting places.

Guadeloupe is now my (6) .......... place in the world. I want to go back again next year!

parts.title: Reading & Writing Part 7
parts.instructions: Look at the three pictures. Write the story shown in the pictures. Write 35 words or more.

checklist.band5: All the content is relevant to the task. The candidate has described all three pictures clearly.
checklist.band3: Some content is relevant but may miss one picture or include irrelevant details.
checklist.band1: Content is mostly irrelevant or too short to assess.

checklist.band5: The story is well-organised with clear sequencing and connecting words (first, then, after that).
checklist.band3: Some attempt at organisation but the story may be hard to follow in places.
checklist.band1: Very little organisation. Ideas are not connected.

checklist.band5: Uses a range of everyday vocabulary and grammar accurately. Spelling is mostly correct.
checklist.band3: Uses simple vocabulary and grammar with some errors that don't prevent understanding.
checklist.band1: Very limited vocabulary. Frequent errors make the text difficult to understand.

parts.sampleAnswer: Last weekend, my friends and I went to the beach to play volleyball. We were having a great time playing together. Suddenly, the ball went into the sea. My friend Tom ran into the water to get it back. He got very wet but we all laughed and continued playing.
